shadow_trades.reasoning_summary: Trading away my only A to go from 1B to 2B would leave me with 0 A, 2 B, 1 C - reducing variety and giving up a good I have equally little of. Since I value equal distribution, this trade doesn't improve my utility.

I currently have equal amounts (1 each) of A, B, and C. Trading away my B for another A would leave me with 2 A, 0 B, 1 C, which is less diverse and reduces utility given my preference for variety. I'd rather keep balanced or trade for something that improves diversity.

Current inventory is 1/1/1, a balanced bundle I value for variety. Trading away my only B for 2 more A would leave me with 3 A, 0 B, 1 C - a highly imbalanced bundle, losing variety value even though total goods increase. I'd rather keep balance or trade for C instead.

Current inventory is 1/1/1, perfectly balanced. Trading away my only C for another B would make me 1 A, 2 B, 0 C, which reduces variety and creates an imbalance. Since I value variety, this trade decreases my utility.

This trade would take me from equal holdings (1,1,1) to (1,0,2), reducing variety and giving me 2 of one good while having 0 of another. That decreases my utility since I value variety equally across goods.
